title: Every scope catalogue is downloaded twice under the fallback locale
legacy: Twig translates on the server (app/config/packages/translation.yaml:5-9): no catalogue is downloaded.
next: core/i18n/provide-i18n.ts:43-44 set fallbackLang 'en' with missingHandler.useFallbackTranslation true, and core/i18n/loading/transloco-http-loader.ts:24-31 does not dedupe. Transloco compares the scoped path 'items/en' to firstFallbackLang 'en', finds them different, and forkJoins the main and the fallback loader on the same path (node_modules/@jsverse/transloco/fesm2022/jsverse-transloco.mjs:586-597). Under /en/ each scope JSON is fetched twice after a client navigation. Under /fr/ the en fallback of each scope is fetched too, which is expected.
evidence: C:/Users/charl/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/F--Git-LeagueOfDataBaseFinal/8504f518-b0ba-4f9d-be95-f2bbdcc96c3e/scratchpad/cmp/audit2/A/misc/i18n-requests.out: /en/ → header Items: /i18n/items/en.json x2 and /i18n/catalogue/en.json x2, four 200 responses, none from the service worker. Same for runes: i18n-requests-runes.out. Direct loads are unaffected (transfer cache).
fix: TranslocoHttpLoader: deduplicate in-flight loads per path. Keep a `Map<string, Observable<Translation>>`, store `http.get(...).pipe(catchError(forbidStorage + rethrow), finalize(() => this.loads.delete(path)), share())` before returning it, and return the stored entry while present. Transloco already caches successful loads itself (this.cache + shareReplay), so no permanent cache is needed, and failedRetries still re-requests. Spec: two concurrent getTranslation('items/en') give one HttpTestingController request, and a failed one is requested again.
verifyReason: Reproduced (verify/v-i18n.out). /en/ to Items fetches items/en.json twice and catalogue/en.json twice. The same happens for runes. /fr/ fetches fr and en once each, as expected. The root cause is confirmed in Transloco 8.4.0 (jsverse-transloco.mjs:586-597): 'items/en' !== firstFallbackLang 'en', so getFallbacksLoaders gets [path, path]. Downgraded to polish: the files weigh 4 to 318 bytes and the requests run in parallel, so nothing is visible and it is not a parity gap.
